description: Returns one action item by id with its full detail: why it matters (rationale), what to do (description and remediation guidance), the tools involved, its status and dates, and the source it came from (source_type and source_id: a Diagnostic, or a Citation, Crawlability or Accessibility Scan). Fits explaining or planning one fix. Fixes happen on the business's own systems with its own access; an item becomes verified only when a later Diagnostic sees the fix from outside. Changes to an action item are made in the Yellowhead app, or through a connection an account admin set up there.
name: get_action_item
title: Get an action item
